title: Geschriebene Liste mit Gesamtzahl versus Dosis oder Grad nach o l r aiiin
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED, posthoc GDT941: f115v38 has ZL/RF o l r aiiin versus IT olr aiiin. Could a written list-total relation constrain bare aiiin independently of choosing a numeral offset?

design.starting_observation: Three separated single-character groups precede aiiin in ZL/RF; IT merges olr. One selected seed only, no enumeration binding identified.
rivals: degree/quantity of a single combined formula
design.required_discriminator: Repeated independently delimited written inventories with variable item counts and a shared written count-binding construction; preserve merged readings and distinguish item total from per-item dose.
design.principal_objection: Proximity and one matching count are not ownership. Text may contain one compound, no list, or a dose unrelated to number of entries. No number word established.
design.primary_review_status: GDT738/754/759 read; closed-family navigation only. Read relevant safe primary scopes before selection; do not open f84 sources. No gate automatically reopened.
